purpose: Evaluate recurrence-native post-training: does teaching the window layers to think in loops move the recurrence curve?

trained_adapter.objective: depth_curriculum_loss (answer-span CE under the engine's recurrent forward + monotonicity hinge)
trained_adapter.note: train seed 777 is disjoint from every eval seed; eval tasks are fresh by construction

hypotheses.h1: adapter-on latent accuracy at recurrent steps 2-8 exceeds adapter-off latent accuracy (the trained window is a better recurrent operator)
hypotheses.h2: adapter-on shows a positive accuracy-vs-steps slope where adapter-off plateaus or degrades
hypotheses.h3: adapter-on full_stack/recurrence arms close the gap to (or beat) vanilla decoding that REFUTED them pre-training

honesty_bounds: 1.5B first: mechanism evidence that TRAINING moves the curve; 32B run follows the same protocol
grader conservatism unchanged (n<20 CONJECTURE, Holm correction, compute voiding)
train-on-family / eval-on-family means gains are within-distribution reasoning-procedure gains, not broad capability claims; broad claims need held-out families
no reruns with new seeds after seeing results
